inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.batchOverviewDescription: Track where each batch is in the physical flow.
inventory.emptyDescription: Batches created from purchases will appear here.
inventory.adjustmentReasonHint: Business reason for the adjustment; stored for audit.
inventory.quantityHint: Quantity of stock to be saved
inventory.detailDescription: Recorded stock facts. Quantities change only through movements and audited adjustments.
inventory.editDescription: Correct recorded facts. Changing the quantity records an adjustment and requires a business reason.
inventory.statusLockedHint: Status changes come from operations (reservations, loadings), not manual edits.
inventory.deleteDescription: This will remove batch <batch>{{batch}}</batch> and its stock from the register. This action cannot be undone.
